description:
Satellite still of a place — a Sentinel-2 ARCHIVE image (the screen as a picture). Pose = lat/lng OR
    entity_type+id (anchor); same pose family as `look_from`. Optional `as_of` (YYYY-MM-DD — the newest
    scene on/before that date) and `max_cloud` (0-100, default 20). AGENT KEYS ONLY (a browser session is
    refused BEFORE any charge). Metered on its own price line — quote it first with
    `billing_quote("/api/v1/look.at")` — and refunded in full if no image is delivered. RETURNS THE IMAGE (jpeg) as MCP image content PLUS `structuredContent` provenance from the
    scene's headers — read these and claim nothing stronger: `observed_at` is the SCENE's date, NEVER the
    request's; `source_tier` is the PROVIDER's, never the pin's; `freshness` is "archive", never "live";
    plus cloud_cover, gsd, extent_km, attribution, cache, entity_cap_consumed (0), and the charge:
    `price_charged_joules` (the all-in price) + `metering_attempt` / `metering_status` — the settle truth for an
    IMAGE, which has no JSON body to carry a `metering` block (the X-Metering-Status header: completed = paid ·
    settled_zero · settle_failed = delivered but UNPAID · released · cached_replay). A cloudy or
    MISSING scene returns `available:false` + `freshness:"unavailable"` and is REFUNDED IN FULL — an
    unavailable RESULT, not an error, and NEVER a fabricated image; that JSON carries top-level `charged_joules`
    (0 — refunded) and the `metering` block described below.Metered: charged to your own wallet — see the server instructions (CHARGING); quote first with `billing_quote`.

as_of.description: Newest scene on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the newest scene.
as_of.title: As Of

entity_type.description: Entity kind: deposit | infrastructure | company | project. With `id`, anchors the still on that entity.
entity_type.title: Entity Type

id.description: Entity id to anchor on (with entity_type).
id.title: Id

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, -90 to 90 (WGS84). Use with lng, or pose on an entity instead.
lat.title: Lat

max_cloud.description: Maximum cloud cover of a scene, 0-100 percent. Default 20.
max_cloud.title: Max Cloud

name: look_at
